lines.text: John sees heaven open and a white horse whose rider is called Faithful and True, with eyes like blazing fire.
The rider's robe is dipped in blood, and the armies of heaven follow Him on white horses dressed in sackcloth.
A sharp sword proceeds from His mouth to strike down the nations, and His robe says KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS.
An angel standing in the moon calls the birds to gather for the great supper of God.
The beast and the false prophet are captured and thrown alive into the fiery lake, and the rest are killed by the rider's sword.
